policy.defaultRemoval: Configured ontology YAML fields, including configured Hidden fields, for notes and placeholders.
policy.otherProperties: Keep unless exact displayed source/field receives fresh Remove or additive Hide consent.
policy.body: Markdown body links and inline ontology are preserved and their source locations remain navigable.
policy.hide: Preserve original links and append a configured Hidden declaration in the selected source note. Hidden is directional; the connection may remain visible from the opposite central note.
policy.preferences: Legacy do-not-ask-again applies only to physical trash confirmation.
policy.coverage: Finite currently indexed sources, explicitly disclosed as incomplete; cumulative decoded preview budget 8 MiB.
